summary: The team is juggling multiple high-priority initiatives, with the China Going-Global report and Asia Start/Intelligent China SEO push at the forefront, while the knowledge website redesign and Indonesia program launch are imminent.
summaryDetail: The most urgent focus is the China Going-Global report, which is in final production: Julie is incorporating IE branding colors, and feedback on the introduction is due this week. Simultaneously, the SEO and program promotion strategy is active, with Asia Start and Intelligent China prioritized; Joseph is drafting target areas and prompts, and the team is analyzing audience profiles and conversion tracking. The knowledge website redesign is moving forward, with Joseph's design elements to be integrated and feedback due on his HTML file. This week, the Indonesia emerging market program webpage must be launched (removing password protection), and the SwissCham membership renewal is starting. Upcoming milestones include finalizing Dean Xiang's topics for Tech In ASIA, sending the first video after feedback, and reviewing the Global Marcom work report by mid-August.
